items.title: Normal by Proxy Brings Shared, Browser-based Jamming For Up To 8 Players
items.summary: GOGDOG's new browser tool lets groups build tracks together in real time, with no downloads, accounts or saving required. Developer GOGDOG has released Normal by Proxy, a free, browser-based space for making electronic music together in real time. Up to eight people can join a session using a five-letter room code, with no download or account needed. The room contains four synths, two drum machines, a mixer and effects, alongside speakers and a text-to-speech "robot" that vocalises whatever users type.
